answer: The pearl is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lantern. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on time-locked work history, clawed back after a replayed submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the dune of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
